title: Affine etale representables on larger affine limits
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme in universe $u$. Let $I$ be a small cofiltered category whose objects and morphisms are in universe $u+1$, let $D:I\to X_{\mathrm{Proet}}$ have affine etale stages, and let $c$ be a cone whose image in schemes over $X$ is limiting. For an affine etale $X$-scheme $V$, the opposite Hom functor $\operatorname{Hom}_{X_{\mathrm{Proet}}^{\mathrm{op}}}(V^{\mathrm{op}},-)$ preserves the colimit of $D^{\mathrm{op}}$. Equivalently maps from the vertex to $V$ factor through stages, and equality of two stage maps is detected after refinement. The affine etale stages and the proetale site are as in [det-pe-classical-definition-continuity-map].

source.place: proposition-characterize-locally-finite-presentation (Tag 01ZC), (1) implies (3); proetale.tex lemma-limit-pullback (Tag 099S); the larger-index version of step 2 of lem-pe-affine-presentation-large-continuity

proof.text: Reflect the specified limiting cone through the fully faithful forgetful functor X.ProEt → Over X. Its opposite cone is a colimit cocone in X.ProEtᵒᵖ. It suffices to show that coyoneda at Vᵒᵖ maps this cocone to a colimit.

For any morphism c.pt → V, apply the larger-index factorization theorem to obtain a stage map D(i) → V with the stated composite. Taking opposites proves joint surjectivity of the coyoneda image cocone.

For two maps out of the same stage whose images at the vertex are equal, apply the larger-index eventual-equality theorem. Taking opposites gives a transition of the filtered Hom diagram making the representatives equal. Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' combines this with joint surjectivity to prove the mapped cocone is colimiting. The theorem preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone then gives preservation of D.op.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01ZC, separate existence and eventual-equality clauses; assembled in Lean using the filtered-colimit criterion of Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.Filtered.

lean.statement:
theorem affineEtale_largeLimit_preservesColimit {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ X.ProEt) (haff : ∀ i, IsAffine (D.obj i).left)
    (het : ∀ i, Etale (D.obj i).hom) (c : Cone D)
    (hc : IsLimit ((Scheme.ProEt.forget X).mapCone c))
    (V : X.ProEt) [IsAffine V.left] [Etale V.hom] :
    PreservesColimit D.op (coyoneda.obj (op (op V)))
